namespace.description: Pre-provisioned namespace; selected by the publisher with template.publish authority and frozen in the immutable Revision. Never a Fleet input.

kubeconfig.description: Protected kubeconfig file path for the pinned provider and Shaula bootstrap owner, authorized to read the existing namespace and manage its Pods/Secrets. Bootstrap adds only the prepared .setup_info key and freezes its Generation Secret. Schema-sensitive: write-only value stored in the immutable SQLite Revision; never enters the Runner Execution Domain.
